Can I add tracking of which epoch each prediction was made in? Maybe then, a confidently incorrect image that was made very early can be chalked up to a model that hadn't learned much yet. Try this later:

class EpochPredictionLogger(tf.keras.callbacks.Callback):
    def __init__(self, generator):
        self.generator = generator
        self.epoch_preds = {}

    def on_epoch_end(self, epoch, logs=None):
        self.generator.reset()
        preds = self.model.predict(self.generator, verbose=0).ravel()
        self.epoch_preds[epoch + 1] = preds

--

epoch_pred_logger = EpochPredictionLogger(valid_generator)

history = model.fit(
    train_generator,
    validation_data=valid_generator,
    epochs=30,
    callbacks=[earlystop, checkpoint, epoch_pred_logger],
)

--

Then later

epoch = 5
df_pred["pred_conf_epoch5"] = epoch_pred_logger.epoch_preds[epoch]
